missed.fact: The deciding rule for claims 6/7 is an updatedAt EQUALITY test plus an mtime gate, not a both-changed test. There is no base or ancestor version and no content comparison. Any differing updatedAt where the file mtime is newer than the cache becomes a conflict, including a one-sided remote edit. Nothing is ever adopted silently except a missing local row (local == null) or equal updatedAt.

The last-writer timestamp never picks a winner, so there is no automatic last-write-wins. But a wrong-clock device can still hide edits. The skip test compares the file's lastModified() with a cached mtime. If a fast-clock device wrote a far-future mtime and this device cached it, later edits with a normal mtime are skipped without parsing and never reach the conflict screen.

Sync only ever writes or reads files. A reminder file deleted from the folder is not treated as a deletion: pushMissingOrStale rewrites it from the local row (file == null -> true), so removing a file resurrects the reminder. Only the isArchived flag propagates deletion.

The conflict list is held in memory and recomputed each sync. The cache is deliberately not advanced for conflicts, and pushMissingOrStale skips conflicted ids, so the conflict persists until resolved.

KEEP_BOTH gives the REMOTE copy a new UUID and a fresh updatedAt. A remote tombstone (isArchived = true) is duplicated as an archived row with no alarm. KEEP_REMOTE upserts the remote row unchanged, without bumping updatedAt.

isArchived carries more than two meanings. recordFired sets it when a one-shot fires, while its notification may still be showing. The widget relies on this, and ReminderDao.getById deliberately has no isArchived filter so sync and the widget can see tombstones.
The only hard delete is FullBackupManager.restore(), which removes rows absent from the backup. That removes local tombstones too, and no sync path purges tombstones or their files.
The FAT 2-second rounding is absorbed by a 5 s tolerance, used only in the push/retry pass. The import skip test is an exact `<=` with no tolerance.
Files with a filename/content id mismatch or a non-UUID-shaped id are skipped, and the skip is not cached. Such files are re-parsed on every sync.

absence_probes.pattern: base/ancestor/lastSyncedUpdatedAt field on Reminder or SyncFileState (only reminderId + lastSeenModifiedEpochMillis exist)
automatic winner (maxOf updatedAt / newer-wins) in ReminderSyncManager
